title: Agent runtime
description: Resource use of a running agent. The numbers cover the agent's process, its current turn and its running tool calls.

conversation.description: The conversation ID, for an agent that runs one process per conversation.

node.description: The node the agent runs on.

memory_bytes.description: The memory used by the agent's processes, in bytes.

binary_bytes.description: The size of the shared binaries the agent's processes reference, in bytes. Large message and tool results are usually stored this way.

processes.description: The number of processes: the agent, plus one for a running turn and one for each running tool call.

message_queue.description: The number of messages waiting in the agent process's mailbox. A number that keeps growing means the agent can't keep up.

reductions.description: The work the agent's processes have done, in BEAM reductions. Compare it between agents, or between two reads, to see which agents use the most CPU.
